title: Conditional full-Q finite-block plus two-tail Cauchy composition
purpose: Compose the R-503 finite-block mixture error with two R-506 weighted-tail bounds into one exact full-Q comparison envelope. The result is a reusable source-owner contract and does not instantiate a sector law, a cylinder state, or an ordered limit.

fixed_scope.functional_and_states: Use unchanged PAH-001 fixed-Q functional and finite Gibbs components, PAH-OMC-010 weighting, PAH-OMC-012 graded domain and PAH-OMC-014 order. No counterterm, rate refit, conditional averaging, new carrier, projection change, beta change or phase selection.
fixed_scope.finite_block: For a common finite index type I, the block values b1,b2 represent the two finite-Q mixture values. R-503 supplies the bound card(I)*(C*e_w+e_a) under its pointwise drift hypotheses.
fixed_scope.tail_terms: t1 and t2 are the omitted weighted tails at the two comparison levels. R-506 supplies |t_j|<=C*tau_j from nonnegative tail weights, a common envelope C and a source-owned tail-mass bound.
fixed_scope.source_owner_role: A source-owned law must instantiate b_j,t_j,e_w,e_a,C,tau_j on the declared cylinder and prove the right-hand side tends to zero in the fixed PAH-001 order. This packet supplies no such instantiation.

lean.scope: Abstract real block and tail values with supplied finite-block and two-tail absolute bounds; no PAH values, weight law or limit is instantiated.

assumptions: A finite common index type I supplies the R-503 block-size factor.
The block comparison has bound card(I)*(C*e_w+e_a).
Each of two omitted tails has absolute value at most C*tau_j.
All displayed quantities are supplied under the unchanged parent conventions.
theorem_contract.conclusion: The full finite-block plus two-tail comparison is bounded by card(I)*(C*e_w+e_a)+C*tau1+C*tau2.
not_supplied: No normalized full-Q sector law, projective kernel or component push-forward.
No source-owned e_w/e_a/tau decay, topology or uniform integrability.
No existence, uniqueness, positivity/normalization or stationarity of omega.
No treatment that can erase the R-484 16/9 defect or turn C_sw=540 into a measure.

boundary_and_uniformity.R-484: The hidden-diagonal boundary defect 16/9 remains in any source-owned component inputs and is not averaged or counterterm-cancelled.
boundary_and_uniformity.R-490: C_sw=540 remains a domination-only input; it is not a sector probability, tail mass or Cauchy constant by itself.
boundary_and_uniformity.limit_order: The parent PAH-001 n and R_max order is unchanged. The composition inequality is finite and does not prove that its right-hand side vanishes.

non_claims: This theorem does not define mu_(n,R), a full-Q Gibbs state or omega.
It does not prove projective consistency, a Cauchy rate, weak cylinder convergence, positivity/normalization, stationarity, closability or a semigroup.
It does not remove the R-484 boundary defect or use C_sw=540 as a measure.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains external stochastic time.
